name: aoe2mc.camera.fov
text: Kamaradda degdega ah waxay ka dhigtaa shayga gacanta lagu hayo inuu ruxo. Si uu u istaago, deji Options > Accessibility Settings > View Bobbing ilaa OFF. Kamaraddu waxay sidoo kale ballaarisaa aragtida, taasoo muujisa khariidad badan. Si aragtida caadiga ah loo haayo, deji Options > Accessibility Settings > FOV Effects ilaa 0 %.

name: aoe2mc.conquest.allies_end
text: Saaxiibada oo keliya ayaa hadhay: heshiisyadii way dhammaadeen. Ciyaaryahanka kaliya ee nool ayaa guuleysta.

name: aoe2mc.controls.attack
text: Weerar: dooro ciidammada dagaalka, kadibna midig guji cadow.

name: aoe2mc.controls.build
text: Dhis: dooro dadka reer miyiga, midig ku guji si aad u furto menu-ga dhismaha, dooro dhismo, kadibna bidix dhulka guji. Shift + bidix guji: dhis badan. Midig guji: jooji.

name: aoe2mc.controls.camera
text: Kamaradda: midig guji spyglass Camera (furaha hotbar 2): waxaad si degdeg ah ugu socotaa sare khariidadda. Shift midig guji: xawaaraha xiga. Midig mar kale guji: waad hoos u duushaa.

name: aoe2mc.controls.garrison
text: Ilaalin: dooro ciidamada, kadibna midig guji dhismahaaga. Menu-giisu wuxuu u ogolaadaa inay soo baxaan. Menu-ga town center: Ring Town Bell.

name: aoe2mc.controls.gather
text: Ururi: dooro dadka reer miyiga, kadibna midig guji geed, dhir midho, miin ama beer.

name: aoe2mc.controls.goto
text: Tag: midig guji kombaaska Go to (furaha hotbar 3): menu-ga town center-kaaga, kooxaha kontoroolka iyo dadka reer miyiga ee fadhiga ah ee xiga.

name: aoe2mc.controls.groups
text: Kooxaha kontoroolka: dooro ciidamada, qaado shay kooxeed (furaha hotbar 5 ilaa 9) oo Shift + midig guji si aad doorashada u kaydiso. Midig guji: dooro kooxda.

name: aoe2mc.controls.head
text: Kontoroolka (qabo carrot on a stick; saf-ficilka ayaa tallaabada xigta muujinaya):

name: aoe2mc.controls.menu
text: Menu-ga ciyaarta: midig guji buugga Game menu (furaha hotbar 4): heshiisyada iyo canshuurta, flare, kaydi, joogsi iyo geedka tignoolajiyada.

name: aoe2mc.controls.move
text: Dhaqaaq: doorasho jirta, midig guji dhulka.

name: aoe2mc.controls.research
text: Cilmi-baadh oo u gudub age xiga: midig guji dhismahaaga, kadibna guji tignoolajiyada ama age xiga menu-kiisa.

name: aoe2mc.controls.select
text: Dooro: bidix guji ciidan. Bidix ku hay oo dhulka eeg: sanduuq doorasho. Midig guji: sii amarro.

name: aoe2mc.controls.train
text: Tababbar: midig guji dhismahaaga (town center, barracks ...) oo guji ciidan menu-kiisa ku jira.

text: Ciyaaryahan %s wuxuu u beddelay dabeecadiisa adiga: %s.

text: Ciyaaryahan %s wuxuu u dejiyay xawaaraha ciyaarta %s.

name: aoe2mc.recap.next
text: Ciyaartu way dhammaatay. Midig guji buuga Recap ee gacantaada si aad natiijooyinka u aragto. Ciyaarta programka ku joogso Ctrl-C console-kiisa.

name: aoe2mc.repair.no_resources
text: Agab kuma filna in %s la dayactiro.

name: aoe2mc.replay.hill_won
text: %s wuxuu haystay monument-ka: guusha King of the Hill ee %s.

name: aoe2mc.replay.join_help
text: Shift laba jeer taabo: aragtida daawadayaasha (ku duul block-yada). Midig guji shayada hotbar: xakamaynta replay.

name: aoe2mc.replay.king_died
text: : boqorku wuu dhintay %s. Regicide: ciyaaryahanku wuu baxay.

name: aoe2mc.replay.live_jump
text: Replay tooska ah: boodka wuxuu joogsanayaa dib-u-dhaca ka dambeeya ciyaarta.

name: aoe2mc.replay.relic_won
text: wuxuu relic-ka u qaadayaa khaanqada oo wuu guuleystay.

name: aoe2mc.replay.restart_jump
text: Server-ku dib buu u bilaabayaa boodka dib-u-noqoshada: ku biir mar kale.

name: aoe2mc.run.welcome_first_paper
text: Tallaabada koowaad: qabo ushka amarka oo bidix guji mid ka mid ah dadkaaga reer miyiga.

name: aoe2mc.treaty.start

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.barracks
text: Dhis barracks: midig guji dadka reer miyiga la doortay, dooro barracks oo geli. Saftii amarka ee hotbar-ka sare ayaa kuu sheegaysa meesha lagu geliyo.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.camera
text: Khariidadda degdeg ugu gudub: midig guji shayga "Camera", soco, kadibna midig mar kale ku guji.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.camp
text: Burburi xerada cadowga dhexda khariidadda: dooro Militia-daada oo midig guji dhismo. Boss bar-ka sare ayaa tallaabada muujisa.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.camps
text: Dhis xero alwaax oo u dhow geedaha iyo mill oo u dhow dhirta midhaha. Sidebar-ka midig wuxuu muujinayaa alwaaxa ay qiimahooda yihiin.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.complete
text: Tababarku wuu dhammaaday. Xiga: ciyaar la bot: python3 game/run.py OUTWorld --play --bot

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.feudal
text: U gudub Feudal Age: midig guji town center-kaaga oo dooro Feudal Age. Sidebar-ka midig wuxuu muujinayaa cuntadaada.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.food
text: Ururi cunto 100: u dir qof reer miyi dhirta midhaha. Sidebar-ka midig wuxuu muujinayaa cuntadaada.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.house
text: Dhis guri: midig guji qofka reer miyiga la doortay, dooro guriga oo geli. Saftii amarka ee hotbar-ka sare ayaa kuu sheegaysa meesha lagu geliyo.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.militia
text: Tababbar Militia 3: midig guji barracks-kaaga oo dooro militia. Sidebar-ka midig wuxuu muujinayaa cuntada iyo dahabkaaga.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.raid
text: Cadowgu dadkaaga reer miyiga ayuu weeraraya! Guji khadka digniinta ee casaanka ah chat-ka si aad halkaas u tagto, kadibna dooro Militia-daada oo midig guji cadowga. Boss bar-ka sare wuxuu muujinayaa caafimaadka ciidanka la doortay.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.select
text: Dooro qof reer miyi: bidix guji mid ka mid ah dadkaaga reer miyiga ushka amarka. Boss bar-ka sare wuxuu muujinayaa ciidanka la doortay, saftii amarka ee hotbar-ka sare wuxuu muujinayaa ficilka xiga.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.tip_barracks
text: TALO: barracks-ku wuxuu tababbaraa askarta cagta. Askarta cagta way jaban yihiin oo dhismayaasha ka adkaan karaan.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.tip_camp
text: TALO: ciidamadaada oo dhan wada weeri. Koox yar ayaa dhimanaysa ka hor inta aysan dhibaato gaysan.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.tip_camps
text: TALO: dhis dhismayaasha keenista agabka agabka ku dhow, si dadka reer miyiga ay waddo gaaban u mariyaan.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.tip_feudal
text: TALO: age-ka xiga wuxuu furayaa dhismayaal, ciidan iyo tignoolajiyad cusub. Dadka reer miyiga ka shaqaysiiya inta aad horumarineysid.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.tip_food
text: TALO: dhirta midhaha ee u dhow mill waa bilow cunto oo badbaado leh. Dambe, beeraha waxay siiyaan cunto aan dhammaanayn.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.tip_house
text: TALO: guri wuxuu siiyaa meel dad 5 ah oo dheeraad ah. Eeg tirada dadka sidebar-ka oo dhis guryo ka hor inta aysan buuxsamin.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.tip_militia
text: TALO: waxaad isku dari kartaa ilaa 15 ciidan dhismo gudahiisa marka agabku kuu filan yahay.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.tip_raid
text: TALO: AoE2 hoodhada magaaladu waxay dadka reer miyiga u dirtaa town center. Dhaqaaqi markay cadowgu magaaladaada weeraro.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.tip_select
text: TALO: khadka Idle ee sidebar-ka midig wuxuu tiriyaa dadka reer miyiga aan shaqo lahayn. U sii shaqo.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.tip_villager
text: TALO: dadka reer miyiga mar walba tababbar waqtiga age-ka hore. Dadka reer miyiga badan waxay siiyaan agab badan.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.tip_wood
text: TALO: dadka reer miyiga si dhakhso ah ayay u ururiyaan agabka dhismaha u dhow. Xero alwaax ku dhis geedaha agtooda.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.villager
text: Tababbar qof reer miyi: midig guji town center-kaaga oo dooro villager. Sidebar-ka midig wuxuu muujinayaa cuntada uu qaadanayo.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.wood
text: Ururi alwaax 50: dooro qof reer miyi oo midig guji geed. Sidebar-ka midig wuxuu muujinayaa alwaaxaada.
